title: trajwarp retargeting configuration
description: One warping trial: the demonstration/scene to start from, the spatio-temporal waypoints and barriers that reshape it, and the optimizer settings used to recover the hand. Mirrors trajwarp.io.config.RetargetConfig.

waypoint.description: A spatio-temporal waypoint: [position_shift, t_in, t_out] with an optional 4th [roll, pitch, yaw] (degrees) rotation. position_shift is added to the demonstration's object position; t_in is the normalized time along the input trajectory (0-1) the waypoint applies to; t_out is the normalized time it is moved to in the output.

barrier.description: An obstacle the object trajectory must avoid: [shape, params].

visual.description: A purely cosmetic mesh placed in the scene for rendering: [mesh_path, params].

agent.description: Hand model driving the demonstration. 'trajectories'/'MANO_right' use the MANO hand; 'Allegro_right' uses the Allegro hand.

task.description: Task name; selects the demonstration data and the tasks/<task>.xml scene fragment.

scene_file.description: MuJoCo scene XML the demonstration plays in (e.g. 'kitchen2.xml').

object_mesh_file.description: Repo-relative path to the manipulated object's mesh (e.g. 'meshes/apple.obj').

learning_rate.description: Adam learning rate for the per-frame hand IK optimization.

n_iter.description: Optimizer iterations per contact frame (after the first).

first_frame_iter.description: Optimizer iterations for the first contact frame (usually larger, to find a good initial pose).

loss_threshold.description: Early-stop threshold on the per-frame contact loss. Defaults to 0.0035 if omitted.

boundary_radius.description: Inflation radius (Minkowski) applied to barriers when warping the OBJECT trajectory around them.

hand_boundary_radius.description: Inflation radius applied to barriers when routing the HAND pre/post-contact segments around them.

new_start_pos_shift.description: Translation applied to the object's start position.

end_final_pos_shift.description: Translation applied to the object's terminal position.

end_obj_pos_shift.description: Additional translation of the terminal object pose (used for placement targets).

waypts.description: Spatio-temporal waypoints that reshape the trajectory in space and time.

extra_pt_count.description: Number of extra interpolation points appended past the contact window (extends the post-contact trajectory).

rotation.description: [roll, pitch, yaw] in degrees applied to align the demonstration's keyframes into the scene frame.

barriers.description: Obstacles the warped object trajectory must avoid.

visuals.description: Cosmetic meshes added to the scene for rendering only; they do not affect the warp.

barrier_weight.description: Weight of the hand-barrier penalty in the IK loss (only used when hand-barrier avoidance is enabled). Defaults to 0.6.

barrier_margin.description: Signed-distance margin for the hand-barrier penalty. Defaults to 0.01.

barrier_n.description: Sharpness exponent of the hand-barrier penalty. Defaults to 2.0.
